newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SBC Warburg recommends buy PT, Telecel.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg recommends buy PT, Telecel.

text.p: SBC Warburg said it recommended the purchase of shares in Portugal Telecom and mobile phone operator Telecel after PT's TMN mobile phone unit, Telecel's only direct rival, announced price cuts.
"Since the price reductions were only to be expected and are better than our assumptions, investors should buy opportunistically on weakness," SBC Warburg said in a statement.
PT and Telecel share prices traded lower on Lisbon bourse. PT closed at 6,105 escudos, down 165, and Telecel at 13,001, down 205.
Last week TMN announced price cuts of up to 30 percent.
